comparisons.name: panel-light
comparisons.description: The panel over the System Preferences window, first application selected, Aqua: its size and 20 pt corners, the material over the panes behind it, the selection tile and the name. The three application icons are Apple artwork and are masked; the example has neutral tiles there. The name is set in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: panel-light-drawing
comparisons.description: The same with the name masked as well, at the stricter threshold: the drawing alone, Aqua.

comparisons.name: panel-dark
comparisons.description: The panel over the System Preferences window, first application selected, Dark Aqua. The application icons are masked, as in panel-light; the name is set in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: panel-dark-drawing
comparisons.description: The same with the name masked as well, at the stricter threshold: the drawing alone, Dark Aqua.

comparisons.name: opens-light
comparisons.description: The switcher as it opens over a flat grey, Aqua: the second application is selected. The backdrop is flat, so the panel is the tint over it and the tile black over that.
